package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	sectionuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/section"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// SectionRelationsHandler handles section-lesson relations.
type SectionRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator        *validator.Validate
	AddLessonUC      sectionuc.AddSectionLesson
	ReplaceLessonsUC sectionuc.ReplaceSectionLessons
	DeleteLessonUC   sectionuc.DeleteSectionLesson
}

// AddLesson handles POST /section-relations/add-lesson/{sectionID}.
func (h SectionRelationsHandler) AddLesson(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sectionID := chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID")
	var req struct {
		LessonID string `json:"lesson_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order    int    `json:"order" validate:"min=-32768,max=32767"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.AddLessonUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionuc.AddSectionLessonInput{
		SectionID: sectionID,
		LessonID:  req.LessonID,
		Order:     req.Order,
	}); err != nil {
		writeSectionRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// ReplaceLessons handles PUT /section-relations/replace-lessons/{sectionID}.
func (h SectionRelationsHandler) ReplaceLessons(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceLessonsUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID"), mapCatalogRelationOrder(req)); err != nil {
		writeSectionRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// DeleteLesson handles DELETE /section-relations/delete-lesson/{sectionID}/{lessonID}.
func (h SectionRelationsHandler) DeleteLesson(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sectionID := chi.URLParam(r, "sectionID")
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	if err := h.DeleteLessonUC.Handle(r.Context(), sectionID, lessonID); err != nil {
		writeSectionRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func writeSectionRelationError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrConflict {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrValidation {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
